messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick cross-team sync — Optimize Toolkit delivery. We need final decision on quant profiles + batching/caching rollout by EOD Thu so we can cut the Dedicated rollout. Who owns the Llama2-7b quant profile and the canary plan? @eng-ml @eng-runtime :eyes:

vikram patel: I can own the Llama2-7b quant profile. Working on q4f16 and q5_1 variants. Need final perf numbers from Staging today; will post bench table here when ready.

aj choi: For batching/caching defaults, proposing conservative defaults for Dedicated GPUs:
```
batch_size: 8
max_latency_ms: 120
enable_prefix_cache: true
cache_ttl_s: 3600
```
These keep p95 latency reasonable while still getting throughput wins. I can open a PR to the config repo. :+1:

lisa ng: Heads up — eng-runtime PR #452 adds the batch coalescer flag we need. Until that merges we can't safely shadow traffic for the new defaults. I've requested review, ETA tomorrow AM.

sahil: Regression alert — perf harness found a tokenization/decoding style shift causing ~0.7% quality delta on our eval set when q5_1 is used. Repro linked: https://ci.redwood/testruns/7842

vikram patel: @sahil can you paste the small failure snippet? I expected noise, not a directional shift.

sahil: snippet:
```
=== sample mismatch ===
orig: "The patient was administered 5 mg of..."
q5_1: "Patient given 5 mg of..."
BLEU drop: 0.7%
```
I pushed a repro job to the quant branch (quant/llama2-7b/q5_1-repro).

maria gonzalez: Ok action items: (1) @vikram finalize perf table + attach CSV by noon, (2) @aj finalize batching defaults PR and add README short rationale, (3) @lisa push/merge PR #452 review -> merge, (4) @sahil run regression guard on quant branch and tag results. I'll compile these into a canary plan outlining traffic splits and monitoring triggers.

eng-ops-bot: CI: Staging tests 84/120 passed; failing tests listed at https://ci.redwood/build/556 (auto-notify).

vikram patel: Will post perf table in ~1.5h. If the q5_1 regressions persist, fallback is q4f16 for the initial canary. :thumbsup:

aj choi: I'll open the PR for batching defaults now and include a small benchmark note comparing p50/p95 for batch sizes 4/8/16.

lisa ng: Pinged runtime reviewers; merging target 10:30am PT tomorrow, I'll update thread as soon as it's in.

maria gonzalez: Thanks — I'll assemble canary steps (traffic % by window + alert thresholds) after noon and drop the rollout doc link here. If anyone can't meet these timelines, please call it out now so we can reassign.
